services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: After you book, you will receive a follow-up email from a team member. Field trips must be booked at least 4-weeks ahead of time. Any questions about field trips or booking can be emailed to education@abkids.org. Field trip pricing starts at $7.00 per child. We do not charge for chaperones, teachers, aides, paras, or other adults necessary for your group to be successful! Full payment must be submitted 4-weeks prior to your Field Trip. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Welcome to Hello Neighbor Summer Camp! Step inside and say “hello” to a world full of curiosity, laughter, and new friends. Designed for children ages 2-3 and their caregivers, this adventure invites little ones to explore their neighborhood through gentle play, creative art, and hands-on sensory experiences. Embark on an extraordinary journey at Backyard Biology Summer Camp! Young scientists and artists will explore the magical connection between nature and creativity through hands-on experiments, creature creation, and more. blurb: Above and Beyond is a non-profit children’s museum located in Sheboygan, Wisconsin. We believe in the power of play to transform lives, encourage connection, and strengthen learning.
